claim: Both call sites are covered by the fix
respinsRef was added mirroring the existing spinTokenRef pattern
spinTokenRef pattern already existed before this fix
respinsRef is the authoritative counter that spin() checks and decrements
spin() previously relied on the respins React state value
respins React state value only updates on the next render
Two rapid clicks in the same event batch could both pass the respins <= 0 guard
The race condition could drive the respins count negative
The fix closes the race condition where two rapid clicks in the same event batch bypass the respins <= 0 guard
